{"chunk_id":"R5-255006-004","collection":"ran5_tdoc_chunks","metadata":{"source":["Ericsson","CATT","CMCC"],"tdocNumber":"R5-255006","title":"Discussion on Modernization of Specification Format and Procedures for 6G"},"point_id":"15823035838961434247"}
From the offline email discussions, RAN5 identified the following requirements: Machine-readable format (e.g., PICS) Tables in JSON format (test configuration tables) Support for specification attachments in ZIP format (e.g., 38.903) Automation capability (e.g., RRM TT) Maintain only the newest version of the specification (most RAN5 specs) Use of intermediate revisions Ability to combine CRs into “Jumbo” CRs Extractable definitions for cross-spec and external use (e.g., ASN.1) Easy maintenance and cross-referencing of extra-large tables (e.g., 38.523-2) Automated alignment of bands/band configurations between RAN4 and RAN5 (e.g., Excel in PRD21) Most of the identified advantages, disadvantages, and requirements are common across all 3GPP groups. Based on the current review, the RAN5-specific requirements appear to be well covered in the overall discussion. Nevertheless, RAN5 participation will remain important in upcoming calls on Objectives 2 and 3 to ensure RAN5 interests are fully addressed.

{"chunk_id":"R5-232374-003","collection":"ran5_tdoc_chunks","metadata":{"source":["CAICT"],"tdocNumber":"R5-232374","title":"Discussion on spurious emission for UE co-existence requirement"},"point_id":"16829313646101759580"}
ned UEs with any Release will not interfere all the recognized co-existent systems. UE shall consider the spurious emission of all protected bands included in the latest Version of spec at the stage of its design. It is up to certification organization to decide which Version of spec can be accepted for UE certification. Observation 5: Some inconsistencies between Releases in RAN4 specs for requirements of spurious emission for UE co-existence are not intentional, but consequence of negligence. With more and more Releases coming up, the inconsistencies will be more and more serious as it is too easy to forget to update the specs of all the previous Releases (e.g., It is not easy for delegates to submit 11 LTE correction CRs from Rel-8 to Rel-18 simultaneously). Proposal 2: RAN5 shall take the latest Release of RAN4 spec as reference for the requirements of Spurious emission for UE co-existence and remove the Release information in minimum requirements and test requirements of Spurious emission for UE co-existence. New bands/new CBWs/or new PCs introduced to later Releases can be excluded if there is no interested operator in RAN5. Proposal 3: Minimum requirements and test requirements of Spurious emission for UE co-existence in TS 38.521-1/-2/-3 and TS 36.521-1 shall be updated as per Proposal 1 and Proposal 2.

tatus Report and CR Review RP-241705 Questions about proposal Rel-19 AI/ML Testability and Interoperability agenda item in RAN5 agenda (context of FR2 OTA Beam Test Setup and methodology study included in Rel-19 AI/ML for NR air interface WI – see details below on AI/ML) Noted RP-241706 All RAN5 CR packs were submitted late to RP#105. This led to intervention by the RAN Secretary causing each CR pack to be handled individually during the meeting instead of being concluded under block agreement. With more than 1000 RAN5 agreed CRs packed in more than 50 CR packs, it ended up really being a painstaking exercise for RAN Chair to call out and approve each CR pack. Most importantly, it was sheer waste of valuable meeting time. RAN understands RAN5 handles a larger number of CRs compared to other WGs but that cannot justify late submission of CR packs. This reflects very poorly on RAN5, which must be avoided in the future. ormance. TR 37.901-5 version 16.0.0 to be published. ITU-R ad hoc RP-200533 Status Report ITU-R Ad hoc from Telecom Italia for information and noted. 5G NR RAN Groups Rel-15 5G-NR Status RAN1: NR Rel-15 very stable – 4 correction CRs RAN2: NR Rel-15 continue to stabilize, 43 correction CRs (SA, NE-DC, NR-DC..), no non-backward compatible changes impacting RAN5 test definition/implementation. Initial analysis of NBC CR ‘R2-2004565 Clarification on the presence of ssb-perRACH-Occasion for the CSI-RS based CFRA-Solution 2’ indicates no RAN5 impact. RAN4: Rel-15 RF Core / RRM Core / RRM Performance maintenance - correction CRs expected to come down in Q3 2020. Rel-16 5G-NR Release-16 ASN.1 is now considered formally frozen. NBC changes will be allowed to handle critical corrections in RP#89-e (Sep 20). Most Rel-16 NR spectrum WIs completed. Half of Rel-16 non-spectrum WIs granted extension to Q3 2020. Rel-16 Performance part likely to be extended into Q1/Q2 2021. CT1: Rel-15 specs stable – 2 correction CRs, no non-backward compatible changes. 5G NR Application Layer Data Throughput Performance Way forward endorsed in RP-201377 to consider ‘Variable Reference Measurement Channels’ study as part of RAN4 Rel-17 Demod work after completion of Rel-16 Performance, likely to be in Q1/Q2 2021. NR FR1 UE SA and EN-DC TRP and TRS RP-201339 – New WID - NR FR1 UE SA and EN-DC TRP and TRS and RP-201378 - New SID on NR FR1 and EN-DC FR1 UE TRP and TRS not treated, expected to be handled at RP#89-e meeting. Handling of Rel-16 TEI Items in RAN5 Following proposals endorsed in RP-200931 as guidance to RAN5: Any minor TEI16 enhancement that has cross WG impact (work as well as specs) would need either a dedicated Rel-16 conformance WI or be part of a basket WI Minor TEI16 enhancements with single WG impact and only need few TCs may not need a dedicated conformance WI, could be handled under TEI16_Test within RAN5 with the following recommended working procedures: A discussion paper together WP should be endorsed by RAN5 before new test cases are introduced under TEI16_Test A document that captures status of all test cases in TS38.523-1 should be maintained by RAN5 for traceability issue Date/Location of RAN Plenary meetings for 2020

Handling of Rel-16 TEI Items in RAN5 Following proposals endorsed in RP-200931 as guidance to RAN5: Any minor TEI16 enhancement that has cross WG impact (work as well as specs) would need either a dedicated Rel-16 conformance WI or be part of a basket WI Minor TEI16 enhancements with single WG impact and only need few TCs may not need a dedicated conformance WI, could be handled under TEI16_Test within RAN5 with the following recommended working procedures: A discussion paper together WP should be endorsed by RAN5 before new test cases are introduced under TEI16_Test A document that captures status of all test cases in TS38.523-1 should be maintained by RAN5 for traceability issue Date/Location of RAN Plenary meetings for 2020

c at the stage of its design. It is up to certification organization to decide which Version of spec can be accepted for UE certification. Bullet b) and c), of Observation 2 is not intentional, but consequence of negligence. Observation 5: Some inconsistencies between Releases in RAN4 specs for requirements of spurious emission for UE co-existence are not intentional, but consequence of negligence. With more and more Releases coming up, the inconsistencies will be more and more serious as it is too easy to forget to update the specs of all the previous Releases (e.g., It is not easy for delegates to submit 11 LTE correction CRs from Rel-8 to Rel-18 simultaneously). The inconsistencies between Releases in RAN4 specs also exists for other requirements, e.g., MOP, OoBB, Narrow band blocking and etc, and RAN5 spec does not consider the inconsistencies for other requirements except spurious emission for UE co-existence.

3GPP TSG RAN WG5 Meeting#90-e R5-210005 Electronic Meeting 22 Feb – 5 Mar 2021 Title: Post RP#90-e Notes Source: TSG RAN WG5 (RAN5) Chair To: RAN5 Cc: Contact Person: Name: Jacob John E-mail Address: jacobjohn@motorola.com Attachments: Introduction Minutes of the Previous Meeting RP-202823 Approved minutes from RP#89, based on the draft version submitted initially in RP-202124. RAN WG Status Reports RP-202125 RAN1; the associated CRs for approval were listed in RP-202126 RP-202127 RAN2; the associated CRs for approval were listed in RP-202128 RP-202795 RAN3; the associated CRs for approval were listed in RP-202130 RP-202131 RAN4; the associated CRs for approval were listed in RP-202824 RP-202133 RAN5; the associated CRs for approval were listed in RP-202134 Matters arising from the RAN5 Status Report and CR Review RP-202133 No comments Approved RP-202134 All CRs packs except RP-202235 approved RP-202235 - Partially Approved R5-206131 and R5-205880 are concluded as ‘Not Pursued’ as these CRs found to be not implementable during post RAN5#89-e meeting implementation by MCC. MCC TF 160 RP-202135 The TF 160 report No comments 2021 TTCN Task List endorsed Approved Status Reports - all noted and any changes to TCD and updated WIDs were approved Red flag RAN Secretary did not flag any Status Reports, so no red flag for WI rapporteurs. Thanks to WI rapporteurs, please keep it up. RAN5 Work Item Proposals – all approved ITU-R ad hoc RP-202138 Status Report ITU-R Ad hoc from Telecom Italia for information and noted. 5G NR RAN Groups Rel-15 5G-NR Status RAN1: NR Rel-15 very stable – 5 correction CRs RAN2: NR Rel-15 continue to stabilize, 29 correction CRs (SA, NE-DC, NR-DC..), No non-backward compatible changes to ASN.1 2 CRs (configuration of first active BWPs; inter-frequency handover capability) identified as potentially NBC on functional level December 2020 version may be a suitable baseline for Rel-16 NR UE Capabilities for most WIs. RAN4: Rel-15 RF Core / RRM Core / RRM Performance maintenance – Only essential corrections agreed (very high threshold applied) Rel-16 5G-NR RAN4 Only outstanding Rel-16 NR spectrum WI NR_n48_LTE_48_coex completed Core part of all Rel-16 NR non-spectrum RF & RRM WIs completed Rel-16 Performance part target extended to Mar 2021 CT1: Rel-15 specs stable – 3 correction CRs (non-3GPP access), no non-backward compatible changes. NR FR1 UE SA and EN-DC TRP and TRS RP-202901 – Introduction of UE TRP (Total Radiated Power) and TRS (Total Radiated Sensitivity) requirements and test methodologies for FR1 (NR SA and EN-DC) postponed as RP#90-e decided only to approve one additional Rel-17 RAN4 non-spectrum related WI due to concerns about RAN4 workload. RP-202868 - RAN planning for Release 17 Endorsed 6 months delay of Rel-17 timelines: Rel-17 stage 2 freeze (relevant for SA/CT) – June 2021 (TSGs#92) Rel-17 stage 3 freeze – March 2022 (TSGs#95) Rel-17 protocol coding freeze (ASN.1, OpenAPI, …) – June 2022 (TSGs#96) Meeting Calendar endorsed for 2022-23 RP-202175 - TSG Calendar for 2022 and 2023 RP-202176 - RAN meeting calendar for 2022 and 2023 RP-202179 - Inclusive Language in 3GPP Specifications (endorsed) RAN5 is encouraged to ask the rapporteurs of the relevant specifications to produce draft CRs for the terminology changes in Rel-17 version of specifications from March 2021. Date/Location of RAN Plenary meetings for 2021
